title: Astrid & William
subtitle: Full Wedding Stationary Suite Design
desc:
Imagined for Astrid and Will’s wedding, this stationery suite set out to capture the effortless romance of an Italian summer: elegant enough to feel like an occasion, relaxed enough to feel like a lakeside celebration.

Drawing inspiration from the timeless romance of Lake Como and sun-drenched Tuscan estates, I designed a suite that channels old-world European opulence while staying light and easy-going. Developed as a spec project, it gave me room to explore every detail, from the first monogram to the final coaster.

The palette is pulled from the natural gardens and stone terraces of a Tuscan villa: soft dusty blue, earthy terracotta, and pops of fresh lemon yellow. The suite includes custom monograms, invitation cards, RSVP cards, table place cards, table numbers, food and drink menus, wine labels, food packaging, coasters and hand fans, all designed to set the tone before the first guest arrives.
details:
ROLE: Designer
TIMELINE: March - May 2026
TOOLS: Illustrator, Photoshop
PIECES: Custom monograms, invitation cards, RSVP cards, table place cards, table numbers, food & drink menus, wine labels, food packaging, coasters and hand fans

title: Kingdom Pushh Gala Magazine
subtitle: Printed Material Design
desc:
The Kingdom Pushh Gala is an annual event celebrating those who serve, shine, and shift culture while staying rooted in their faith. Through storytelling, worship, recognition, and fellowship, it is more than a night of celebration: it is a prophetic call to purpose, unity, and legacy. As the first gala in the series, it needed a printed piece that did justice to that vision.

I designed the event magazine entirely from scratch, working directly with the founders. With a tight turnaround, and with the added responsibility of consolidating and properly representing a brand identity that was just taking shape, there was no room for anything less than perfect. Every spread had to feel unmistakably authentic to the brand, celebrating excellence and impact in faith-based communities throughout. 

The magazine guides guests through the night: the order of events, the honourees being celebrated, and profiles of each judge and special guest, so everyone knew who was in the room and what was happening. I also designed bespoke ad spreads for the event’s sponsors, giving each one a place in the story without losing the cohesion of the whole publication.
details:
ROLE: Designer & Curator
TIMELINE: October - November 2025
TOOLS: InDesign, Photoshop, Canva
PIECES: Magazine design, advertisement design
